items.text:
## What this project does

**harbor** is a small static site generator. It turns Markdown pages into HTML using Go templates.

| Folder | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `content/` | Markdown pages and their front matter |
| `templates/` | Go templates used to render pages |
| `public/` | Generated output, replaced by each build |

## Main entry point

`main.go` contains `main()`. It dispatches the `build` command to `Site.Build()` in `build.go`, or the `serve` command to a local preview of the generated output.

Start with `main.go` for command handling and `build.go` for page rendering.

## Tests

`build_test.go` contains `TestBuildRendersPages`. It creates a temporary page and template, builds the site, and checks the generated HTML.

The test command, from the repository root, is:

```sh
go test ./...
```

I only read the files. **No tests were run, no dependencies were installed, and no files were changed.**
